hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/mypy ]; then jq -n '{systemMessage:"hibrid: skipped the mypy --strict check - no .venv/bin/mypy. Run: python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e \".[dev]\""}'; exit 0; fi; out=$(.venv/bin/mypy src 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "$out" '{decision:"block", reason: ("mypy --strict found type errors after this edit:\n" + $r)}'; fi ;; esac; }
